sniper_keen_scope.name: Keen Scope
sniper_keen_scope.description: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every %bonus_damage_distance% units of distance Sniper is from the target.

sniper_shrapnel.name: Shrapnel
sniper_shrapnel.description: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every %abilitychargerestoretime% seconds.
sniper_shrapnel.facet_sniper_scattershot: Shrapnel slow and damage are increased, but duration is decreased.
sniper_shrapnel.lore: Cardel’s versatile rifle can fire incendiary rounds, especially effective in trench warfare.
sniper_shrapnel.note0: Deals damage 11 times — upon activation and once each second thereafter.
sniper_shrapnel.note1: Does not deal damage to buildings.
sniper_shrapnel.note2: Reveals the fog of war in the affected area.

sniper_headshot.name: Headshot
sniper_headshot.description: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal %damage% extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by %slow%%%.
sniper_headshot.lore: Hunting mountain beasts, young Cardel perfected the art of tracking enemy movement.

sniper_take_aim.name: Take Aim
sniper_take_aim.description: Passively increases Sniper's attack range by %passive_attack_range_bonus%.\n\nOn cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by %slow%%% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.
sniper_take_aim.lore: Cardel always tries to stay as far from danger as possible, without forgetting his main goal: precise shooting.

sniper_assassinate.name: Assassinate
sniper_assassinate.description: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
sniper_assassinate.scepter_description: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
sniper_assassinate.lore: To fulfill the prophecy and return home, Cardel must ensure his next shot is as true as the one he fired on the day of his trial.
sniper_assassinate.note0: The targeting icon is only visible to allies.
sniper_assassinate.note1: The projectile cannot be disjointed by invisibility.
